wf.title: Logo Refinement and Marketing Material Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a designer to refine my existing real estate logo and create cohesive business cards and marketing materials. Requirements: - Logo: Tweak text, spelling, or font for clarity while maintaining the current look. - Business Cards: Design to match the updated logo. - Marketing Materials: Flyers, brochures, etc., keeping a consistent brand image. Ideal Skills: - Graphic Design expertise - Experience in real estate branding - Attention to detail - Strong typography skills Please provide samples of previous work.
wf.summary: Client wants a real estate logo with clearer text/spelling, plus matching business cards and flyers/brochures.
wf.skill: Briefing the client: confirming what must stay the same
wf.pitch: I'd love to help refine your real estate logo so the text is clearer while keeping the look you already have. I'll also design matching business cards and a flyer so your brand looks consistent everywhere. Would you like to share the current logo file so I can start?

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need most: a brand new logo, or a cleaned-up version of the existing logo that keeps its look?
options: A brand new logo from scratch
A clearer version that keeps the current look
Only the business cards, no logo changes
practice.why: They asked to tweak text, spelling, or font while keeping the current look. Preserve the brand's recognition and fix clarity. Don't redesign it from zero. Matching the cards and flyers to that updated logo comes next.
practice.need: I'll refine your logo's text and typography while keeping its look, then match your cards and flyers to it.

wf.title: Canva Posts & Posters Designer
wf.brief: I regularly announce events, limited-time offers, and other updates on social media and need a skilled Canva designer to translate each brief into polished visuals that fit my brand guidelines. Most of the work revolves around two key formats: • Instagram posts (square 1080×1080) • Posters suitable for both digital promotion and print On occasions when an Instagram story or an alternative size is requested, the same design language should carry across. For every assignment I’ll provide the copy, logo files, colour palette, and any reference imagery. Your deliverables will be: • An editable Canva link for each design • Exported high-resolution PNG/JPG files (and a print-ready PDF for posters)
wf.summary: Client needs Canva designs for Instagram posts (1080x1080), posters, and stories, matching brand guidelines and provided copy.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need from each design beyond looking nice?
options: Fancy artwork that impresses other designers
Consistent on-brand visuals that carry the event or offer clearly
The most colourful design possible every time
practice.why: Clients post these to announce events and offers, so each design must match the brand and make the message instantly clear. Pretty alone won't sell the offer.
practice.need: I'll turn your event and offer briefs into on-brand Canva posts and posters, ready for Instagram and print.

wf.skill: Briefing the client and matching brand guidelines
wf.pitch: I'd love to design your Instagram posts and posters in Canva, keeping everything true to your brand colours and logo. For each brief I'll send an editable link plus high-res PNG/JPG files, and a print-ready PDF for posters. Would you like to share a sample brief to start?

wf.title: Promotional Social Media Post Graphics
wf.brief: I need a creative designer to craft eye-catching post graphics for my feed that focus on promoting my products and services. The visuals must feel cohesive across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn while still respecting the nuances of each platform. Expect to work with existing brand colours, fonts, and a style guide I will share, then translate that into scroll-stopping imagery paired with concise, high-impact copy placeholders. Deliverables: • At least six static feed posts, supplied in native design files (PSD or AI) plus ready-to-upload PNG/JPEG exports in platform-specific sizes. • Editable text layers so I can update offers and captions. • A quick usage note showing layout grids, font
wf.summary: Client wants six cohesive social post graphics (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn) using their brand style guide, with editable text layers.

practice.q: What does the client REALLY need beyond just pretty posts?
options: Six random eye-catching designs in any style
Consistent branded visuals that promote offers across platforms
A full social media strategy and posting calendar
practice.why: Cohesion and brand consistency matter more than novelty here. Read the style guide closely, then adapt each post to each platform's sizes and feel, with editable text so offers can change easily.
practice.need: I'll deliver six platform-sized, on-brand post graphics with editable text layers for your offers.

wf.skill: Turning a client's brand brief into consistent visuals
wf.pitch: Hi, I can create six on-brand post graphics for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn using your colours and fonts, with editable text layers so you can update offers easily. I'll send native PSD or AI files plus ready-to-upload exports and a short layout guide.

wf.title: Modern Company Brochure Design
wf.brief: I'm looking for a modern and professional brochure to introduce my company and its services. The brochure will be shared with potential clients at meetings or events. The brochure should include: - Company story - Past jobs - Services - Contact details Ideal skills and experience: - Strong graphic design skills - Experience with brochure layouts - Ability to convey information clearly and attractively - Portfolio showcasing modern and professional designs Please provide samples of similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a modern, professional company brochure with company story, past jobs, services and contact details, shared at meetings and events.

practice.q: What does the client really need the brochure to do once it's in a prospect's hands?
options: Look pretty on a shelf
Win trust and start conversations
Show every past project in detail
practice.why: Good call. A brochure handed out at meetings has one job: make a stranger trust you enough to call. Lead with clarity and credibility, not decoration. Keep text short and scannable.
practice.need: I'll design a clean, modern brochure that tells your company story and services clearly, ready for print.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: finding the real goal behind the request
wf.pitch: Hi, I read your brief for a modern company brochure. I'll design a clean, professional layout covering your story, past jobs, services and contact details, with print-ready files. Would you like to see a sample layout first?

wf.title: Event Graphics Design Specialist
wf.brief: I am looking for a graphic designer to design a poster for an upcoming performance. Our director did a mockup using ChatGPT, but I would like to hire a human to make the artwork. Must NOT use AI to generate your design. Looking to have the attached image recreated in your own style. Please provide a portfolio showcasing similar work.
wf.summary: Client wants a human-designed event poster, recreating an attached mockup in the designer's own style, no AI-generated art.

practice.q: The client says 'recreate the attached image in your own style.' What is the client really asking for?
options: Copy the mockup pixel for pixel
Rebuild the same layout with your own design choices
Generate a new poster with an AI tool
practice.why: They want the mockup's layout and message kept, but the artwork drawn and styled by you. Copying exactly or using AI both miss the point.
practice.need: I'll rebuild your poster by hand in my own style, keeping your mockup's layout and key info.

wf.skill: Briefing the client: clarifying what 'recreate' means
wf.pitch: Hi, I can design your performance poster by hand, keeping the layout and key details from your mockup while giving it my own clean style. I'll send you a first draft within two days for feedback. Would you like to share the event date, venue, and any brand colours?

wf.title: Modern Celebration of Life Booklet

practice.need: I'll deliver a clean, modern fold-and-staple booklet layout fast, with photos and memories placed neatly.

wf.skill: Reading what the client really needs before designing
wf.pitch: I can design a clean, modern fold-and-staple booklet that places your photos, family memories and personal messages neatly, and I can turn a print-ready file around quickly. Would it help if I sent you a quick layout preview today?

cv.skill: Turning existing experience into achievement bullets

Could you share your current documents and a target role so I can start?

Fast, captioned, scroll-stopping edits on-brand
Static slideshows with a voiceover only

ig.title: Polish Social Media Clips

practice.why: Good work here means each post sells the visit. Pretty images alone won't bring people in. Put the call to visit, the address, hours, and directions right alongside the offer, then schedule it.
practice.need: I'll schedule daily FB and IG posts that drive store visits, with address, hours, and specials.

ig.pitch: I can set up your daily Facebook and Instagram posts at 8am, noon, and 5pm, each with a clear 'come see us today' call, your address, hours, and specials. Would you like me to start with this week's offers?
